LIFTS

Winter is Coming!

Snow is starting to fall up here, and we’re eagerly awaiting consistently cold temperatures so we can fire up the snowmaking guns and start spinning lifts! Until then, enjoy the skin tracks and the fast grass!

If you’re looking to purchase day tickets for the upcoming season, don’t worry—we’re not sold out!

Day tickets will go on sale as we get closer to opening day, most likely during the first week of December.

Stay tuned for more details!

Think Snow!

Keep an eye on all of the action by visiting our webcam page sponsored by Mad River Valley Real Estate.

Follow us on Instagram and Facebook.
